thesis: Selected moving-business coaching distinguishes differentiation from competing primarily on price.
summary: The reviewed passages describe a residential moving company charging hourly and a discussion of matching offers on scope before matching prices. The advisor favors a value-based position unless low cost is the deliberate business strategy. This selected review does not substantiate all growth tactics or outcomes described in the automatic guide.
